audits.rationale: detect_stubs.py was invoked against T1.2's edit to severity-taxonomy.md per the per-task-quality discipline. One INFO-level finding surfaced: the word 'TODO' appears inside a prose rule that prohibits TODO usage as a placeholder value (backtick-wrapped within the same sentence that disallows it). Dispositioned as a stub-detector false-positive at task-quality time; the prose is correct as authored. No real stub or placeholder present. No other audit modules in scope for Phase 1 (FR-1 Lens 4 lands in Phase 4; SA-14 lands in Phase 7; Blocks-X parser lands in Phase 3).

findings.divergence: Stub detector matched the literal token TODO; the token appears inside a prose rule that explicitly prohibits TODO as a target-field value. The match is structurally correct (token present) but semantically a false-positive (the prose is the prohibition itself, not a stub).
findings.next_action: Informational only; no remediation required. Disposition recorded at task-quality time. Carry forward as a known false-positive shape for future runs of detect_stubs.py against prose that quotes prohibited tokens.
